newsitem.title: SWEDEN: ATHLETICS-KIPKETER EQUALS OLDEST WORLD TRACK RECORD.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-KIPKETER EQUALS OLDEST WORLD TRACK RECORD.

text.p: Dane Wilson Kipketer equalled the oldest track record on the books on Monday when he clocked one minute 41.73 seconds for the men's 800 metres at the Stockholm Grand Prix.
The world champion, who was born in Kenya but now runs for Denmark, equalled the mark set by Briton Seb Coe in Italy 16 years ago.
Kenyan Bernard Kisilu took a classy field through the first lap in 49.22 seconds with Kipketer seemingly off the pace.

But the Dane, who was not allowed to compete at last year's Atlanta Olympics, picked up the pace on the back straight, eased into the lead with 200 to run and strode powerfully down the finishing straight.
The winning time was given as 1:41.74 but adjusted down by 0.01 of a second as Kipketer was jogging his victory lap.
